stem.text: A fixed volume and concentration of substrate and enzyme were mixed. All other variables were kept constant. The enzyme-catalysed reaction was left until it was complete.
Which graph shows how the rate of reaction changes with time?

A.alt: Graph with y-axis labelled rate of reaction and x-axis labelled time, showing a single line.

B.alt: Graph with y-axis labelled rate of reaction and x-axis labelled time, showing a single curve.

C.alt: Graph with y-axis labelled rate of reaction and x-axis labelled time, showing a single curve.

D.alt: Graph with y-axis labelled rate of reaction and x-axis labelled time, showing a single curve.
